scope: Radiance1.17.0/IQ3R-Sv4 integration and its controller package dependency closure; no model-generated utility rewrite.

findings.trigger: Ship the Linux radiance/all console or Windows console, then select embedded MTP/DFlash.
findings.evidence: Four isolated package cases failed with missing backends/radiance/tools/draft_control.py.
findings.fix: Include draft_control.py beside inspect_rad.py in both package manifests.
findings.validation: Actual generated radiance/all packages resolve MTP3 and DFlash7 outside the source checkout; Windows bundled Python resolves DFlash7.

findings.origin: Pre-existing console package dependency omission, confirmed in the frozen Nov4 source; packaging only, no change to legacy inference behavior.
findings.evidence: Actual offline package failed in local-console.py/console_chat.py with ModuleNotFoundError: console_radiance. Linux used the same incomplete dependency list.
findings.fix: Include console_radiance.py in both package manifests; copy required Radiance tool fixtures into the Windows packaging test source.
findings.validation: Linux packaged entry --help and complete Windows offline-package/HTTP integration pass.

findings.origin: Shared launcher regression introduced when adding metadata preflight; native magic reader and existing launcher accept the extension.
findings.trigger: Select MTP or DFlash with a valid model named *.RAD.
findings.evidence: Both new shared-launcher subcases failed at draft_control.resolve suffix validation.
findings.fix: Compare the model suffix case-insensitively while preserving directory completeness and drafter checks.
findings.validation: Shared launcher MTP3/DFlash7 and isolated packaged .RAD cases pass.

limitations: Model output quality is not certified: V4 DFlash7 batch acknowledgement7/31 and MTP3 acknowledgement8/31; generated regex counters miscount string-literal decoys. These are unmodified generated outputs, not integration code fixes.
Canonical low-resolution OCR remains21/22; ordinary native reproduces the same miss.
Windows native inference, TP2, general profile, packed KV/full-model f16 state and JPEG model requests remain unqualified.
DFlash3 was deliberately cancelled by the user; its partial run is not a completed comparison.
build_scope: No native configure/build/clean; reuse unchanged validated native source/binary. Windows package integration uses a verified immutable Python3.12.10/psutil7.2.2 bundle.
